fields.issue: The 014b beryllium point on CR-III 5056 at 1.6 pcf has least SF 0.668649769508548 by global buckling at kd 0.20. Face wrinkling on that same split is 0.6688 and does not contain kd. Raising kd to 0.2991 brings only the global mode to SF 1. The least factor stays 0.6688. Re-optimising the mass split on the same core and the same structural mass reaches least SF 0.8536 at kd 0.3 and crosses 1 at kd 0.519 by face yield.
fields.consequence: A shape tolerance bought at kd 0.3 does not put this point's least factor at 1. The global-only scaling is the order's 0.299, and it is not the least factor.
fields.next: If a later card chases SF 1 on this core, use the re-optimised split and kd 0.519, not the frozen split at kd 0.3.
